name: grand-rounds
description: Evidence-first medical presentations: interview, plan, PubMed-backed research, figures and motion graphics, HTML or PPTX build, and audits for AI slop and citation accuracy.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-first medical slide decks: journal clubs, lectures, cases, guideline updates
interface.longDescription: Grand Rounds interviews you about the talk, writes a plan for your approval, researches and records every claim with its source, builds figures (including original Kaplan–Meier vectors and mechanism animations), renders HTML or PPTX in your institution's template, then audits the deck for AI-slop patterns, wrong numbers and unverifiable references.
defaultPrompt: Make a journal club deck on this paper
Audit my conference slides before tomorrow
